name: Kodo Graveyard
summary: In central Desolace, kodos make their way to Kodo Graveyard to die among their ancestors. Their bones cover a broad stretch of grey earth.

sections.title: Resting Place of Titans
sections.body: Ancient bones lie across Kodo Graveyard, some from beasts far larger than any living kodo. When a kodo nears its end, it comes here to spend its last breaths among centuries of remains. Scavengers prowl the edges. Disturb the calcified ribs or skulls, and furious kodo spirits may rise from the dust.

sections.title: A Land of Spirits
sections.body: Restless spirits wander among Kodo Graveyard’s bones. Those who look into the spirit realm can see towering kodo apparitions moving silently through the dust storms. Nearby, the Horde keeps watch from Ghost Walker Post. They guard the sacred grounds and watch over the herds and spirits that linger among the bones.

faq.q: Why do the kodos come here to die?
faq.answer: When kodos grow ancient, fall sick, or near death, instinct drives them across the waste to lie among their ancestors’ skeletons in this part of Desolace.

faq.q: Why are some of the skeletons so enormous?
faq.answer: Some skeletons are much larger than the living kodos nearby. Their exact age and origins remain unknown.

faq.q: What happens if someone disturbs the bones?
faq.answer: Disturbing the remains can provoke the dead. Vengeful kodo apparitions appear and attack those who scavenge or desecrate the resting place.
Ghost Walker Post is a small Horde camp beside the bone fields. Horde travelers can rest there, watch the region’s spiritual activity, and find guidance through central Desolace.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the kodo as a revered partner and spiritual companion. Desecrating these ancestral resting grounds is a grave matter.
As an herbalist, you can gather Grave Moss around the large skeletons. The decaying remains and spiritual resonance enrich the ground.
